MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "A streaming stick feels like a useful addition to my TV and DVD playback setup because it would give me another way to watch content, provided the connections work with my TV.",
    "The different streaming sticks address the same practical need, so I would compare them and choose one; the streaming function is what interests me."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "My tripods, memory cards, and lens cap support taking photographs; they do not imply that I want surveillance cameras or a video doorbell.",
    "Owning a Fire tablet does not give me a current need for voice speakers, calling displays, or a dedicated reader. Each would need a specific purpose beyond what I already use.",
    "The gaming controller and themed remote cover add features I have shown no interest in; my interest in a streaming stick comes from watching TV."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been taken as interest in a broad range of Amazon devices, even though I bought accessories for specific uses.",
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into interest in smart-home monitoring, voice control, and gaming without a clear connection to my needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy practical accessories such as storage cards, cables, mounts, protective cases, and power strips that help equipment I already own work better.",
    "Compatibility matters to me: the device, connector, card format, or lens size an accessory supports can make it useful or irrelevant.",
    "My recent purchases include a lens cap and a DVD player, which give clearer reasons to consider photography accessories and TV playback equipment than additional smart displays."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized a plausible interest in TV streaming but stretched my practical electronics purchases into broader interests in smart-home devices and entertainment extras."
}
